title: My numbers
subtitle: Enter your numbers month by month. The rest of the app updates automatically.
manualTitle: Some metrics are still entered manually
manualHelp: Conversations and proposed calls come from your monthly entry. Connect a call tracking tool to fill booked and attended calls automatically.
manualHelpConnected: Conversations and proposed calls come from your monthly entry. Booked and attended calls now come from your connected call tracking data.

bottleneck.title: Active bottleneck data
bottleneck.subtitle: Find the steps and volumes already present in the app for the active journey. Changing the journey no longer creates pages in Acquisition.
bottleneck.journeyHelp: Each step uses the canonical data shared by the dashboard and diagnostic.
bottleneck.currentHelp: Volumes recorded for {month}. A dash means the data has not been measured yet.
bottleneck.emptyHelp: Configure your journey in My business to show the required data.
bottleneck.historyHelp: The same steps are tracked over time without creating new metrics.
bottleneck.canonicalSource: Canonical source: these volumes are read from data already saved in My numbers, connected integrations and sales tracking.

modal.settingSource: Calculated from your daily tracking. Editable in Pipeline → Daily funnel.
modal.closingSource: Calculated from your daily tracking. Review the call records in Call tracking.
modal.intro: Add {month} data in seconds. Falco can recognize your table automatically.
modal.falcoTitle: Falco sorts your table for you
modal.falcoHelp: Upload a CSV/Excel file or paste your cells. It maps the right numbers to this month's 9 metrics, then shows you the result before validation.
modal.valuesReadyHelp: Review the fields, then click Save to confirm.
modal.stripeStale: Stripe is disconnected. Numbers are frozen as of {date}. You can enter this field manually again.
modal.salesSuggestion: Sales tracking totals {contracted} contracted and {collected} collected this month.

modal.salesSource: Sales tracking supplies {count} closed sale{plural} this month.
modal.closingConnected: These closing metrics come from connected call tracking and sales data.
modal.newCustomersCombinedSource: Stripe supplies {stripeCount} new customer{stripePlural}. Sales tracking adds {salesCount} bank transfer customer{salesPlural}.
modal.newCustomersSalesSource: Sales tracking adds {count} bank transfer customer{plural}.
modal.settingCalculated: These 5 KPIs are calculated from your daily tracking.
modal.overrideHint: You can correct these values for review. A change will be saved as a monthly override after Save.
modal.overrideActive: Monthly override active: your values take precedence over daily tracking for this month.
modal.contentSuggestion: Your Content posts total {count} leads this month.
modal.pipelineConversationsSuggestion: Your Acquisition pipeline has {count} conversation{plural} started this month.
modal.pipelineBookedSuggestion: Your Acquisition pipeline has {count} call{plural} booked this month.
modal.closingCalculated: These 2 KPIs are calculated from your daily tracking.
modal.salesClosedSuggestion: Sales tracking has {count} sale{plural} closed this month.
modal.pipelineTakenSuggestion: Your Acquisition pipeline has {count} call{plural} attended this month.
